Tess: quick handoff — i'll be off at 23:00PT, handing primary to @Lee. leaving the usual TL;DR and a few extra pointers for inference-prod spikes.
Lee: ack, i'll be primary from 23:00 PT. what's the biggest risk tonight?
Tess: main thing is the nightly batch inference job that spikes memory for the 2x seq models. if you see sustained 5xx or OOMs, try these in order: 1) drop to the short-seq variant, 2) evict prefix cache for that model, 3) scale out replica count.
IncidentBot: ALERT (auto): last 5m 5xx rate on inference-prod: 2.8% — potentially client impact. Pager rules: sev2 if >2% sustained 5m.
Rishabh: ping — that batch job is scheduled 00:15 PT, i already queued a canary run that should catch regressions.
Tess: good. quick commands i use for triage:
```
# check pods and restarts
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide
# look for OOMKill in k8s events
kubectl describe pod <pod> -n inference | grep -i oom
# check logs for top error
kail -n inference | grep -m 50 "ERROR"
```
Maya: runbook links (short) — follow these in order depending on symptom:
- high-5xx / latency: https://console.redwood/runbooks/inference/5xx-latency 
- OOMs / scale: https://console.redwood/runbooks/inference/oom-scale 
- degraded KV cache: https://console.redwood/runbooks/inference/kv-cache-evict 
- release rollback: https://console.redwood/runbooks/deploy/rollback-guidance
Lee: noted. any coverage gaps?
Tess: secondary gap 00:00-04:00 PT — @Rishabh you said you were on call but might be in a meeting? if you can't cover, tag backup (Maya). we should avoid single-person night.
Rishabh: i can be reachable for the first hour, then i'll tag Maya if needed. leaving an escalation matrix here: primary -> secondary -> oncall lead (pager) -> eng-sre oncall.
OncallBot: BRIDGE created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1861204321 (use if multiple teams needed).
Tess: quick remediation snippets for common pages:
- eviction of prefix cache (fast): `curl -X POST https://internal-api/cache/evict?model=short-seq`
- scale up replicas (temporary): `kubectl scale deployment inference-short-seq --replicas=5 -n inference`
- fallback to cheaper model variant in prod routing: edit route `inference-route` -> set model: `short-seq-v2` (console or API)
Lee: how do we notify customers if we hit degraded SLA?
Tess: if >5% 5xx for 15m escalate to status@ and open a support ticket: https://console.redwood/support/new, use template "pg-inference-deg". add affected customers from the alert context.
Maya: adding small checklist for night: 1) verify canary run at 00:10, 2) confirm autoscaler active (HPA metrics), 3) have bridge link handy, 4) tag oncall lead on persistent sev2 >20m.
Lee: got it — i'll post a brief summary once i take over and ping if anything starts trending. thanks Tess. :thumbsup:
Tess: thanks — leaving my mobile in the thread if needed: +1-555-0102. good luck.
